macro.title: Felt a ‘big bang’: Firework strikes Delta flight landing in Chicago - NBC News
macro.summary: A Delta flight was struck by a firework while descending into Chicago on July Fourth, according to the airline.

macro.title: Metro Detroit residents surprised, dismayed to spend July 4 weekend without power - The Detroit News
macro.summary: Power is not expected to be restored until late Wednesday for some Michigan victims of the extreme weather over the July 4 holiday weekend.

macro.title: EasyJet Agrees to Castlelake’s £5.2 Billion Takeover Offer - Bloomberg.com
macro.summary: EasyJet Plc agreed in principle to a takeover offer of more than £5 billion from Castlelake LP, which swooped in as the UK budget carrier was reeling from soaring jet fuel prices and suppressed demand after the Iran war.

macro.title: National wireless carrier shuts down after Chapter 11 - thestreet.com
macro.summary: While its parent company will survive, the phone service that offered a low price for a "lifetime" won't.

macro.title: Oil prices hover near pre-conflict levels as OPEC+ boosts output again - Fox Business
macro.summary: OPEC+ approved a new production increase for August as recovering crude supplies and easing geopolitical concerns kept oil prices near pre-conflict levels.
